simba.Codes.Wake_T.Wake_T module

Simframe Wake-T Module

Various objects and functions to handle Wake-T lattices and commands. See Wake-T github for more details.

Classes:

  • waketLattice: The Wake-T lattice object, used for converting the frameworkObject s defined in the frameworkLattice into a Wake-T lattice object, and for tracking through it.

all_subclasses(cls)[source]
class waketLattice(**data)[source]

Bases: frameworkLattice

Class for defining the Wake-T lattice object, used for converting the frameworkLattice into an Wake-T lattice object, and for tracking through it.

Parameters:

data (Any)

allow_negative_drifts: bool

Allow drifts to be of negative length (could be necessary for plasma injection)

beamline: Any

Wake-T Beamline object

bunch_list: Optional[List[Any]]

List of Wake-T ParticleBunch object produced by tracking

code: str

String indicating the lattice object type
